figurative_meaning_en: A dark, ugly, and fat person
example_sentences_in_bangla: সেই ধূম্রলোচনের মতো লোকটি গ্রামে এসে সবাইকে ভয় দেখাল।
ওর চেহারা দেখলে মনে হয় ধূম্রলোচনের ছায়া।
example_sentences_in_english: That dark, ugly, fat person came to the village and scared everyone.
Looking at his appearance, he seems like the shadow of Dhumorlochan.
history: Refers to the demon Dhumorlochan from the Devi Mahatmya in Hindu scriptures, depicted as a grotesque figure with smoky eyes sent by Mahishasura to fight Goddess Durga.
note: This idiom draws from Hindu mythology, often used in Bengali folklore to describe someone with an intimidating or repulsive physique.
